test_title: PYST 3: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will most suitably substitute the underlined part of the given sentence.

He was not happy __until he gave up his job and live__ as a fakir in the forests.

options.text: until he gave up his job and lives
until he gave up his job and lived
unless he gave up his job and lives
until he gives up his job and lived

solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. "until he gave up his job and lived".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence uses the past tense **"gave up" **and the present tense **"live**," which is inconsistent.
 
• For parallel structure and correct verb tense, both actions ("gave up" and "lived") should be in the past tense.
 
• **Option 2** correctly uses the past tense for both verbs: **"gave up"** and **"lived."**
 
• Options 1, 3, and 4 do not maintain the correct tense consistency or parallel structure.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence: *He was not happy until he gave up his job and lived as a fakir in the forests.*
